header.rule: Take a set of table numerals that, with the card you play, adds to 11. Aces count 1 through tens 10; J, Q and K never join the sum and only take the same rank from the table. Capturing is compulsory when a capture exists. Emptying the table is a "soor": the cards from that capture score double.

actions.mustCapture: A capture is available, so this card cannot be laid down
actions.takeSoorAria: this choice empties the table, doubling the cards you take

hint.pasurSoor: This empties the table -- that capture scores double.
hint.pasurTrail: Nothing adds to 11. Lay down your least valuable card.

tutorial.rule: Take table numerals that, together with the card you play, **add to 11** (ace = 1, ten = 10). **One card alone never captures** — no card is worth 11.
tutorial.face: **J, Q and K never join the sum.** They only take **the same rank** from the table, which is why a face card left there cannot be shifted by numerals.
tutorial.soor: Emptying the table is a **soor**, and the cards from that capture **score double**. At the end, whatever is left on the table goes to **whoever captured last**.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Press a card that can capture and its options appear. While a capture is available that card **cannot be laid down**.
